summary: NeuroSense Therapeutics Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting an amendment to its existing Capital on Demand Sales Agreement with JonesTrading Institutional Services LLC. The amendment merely updates references from a prior Form F-3 registration statement to a newly effective one, allowing sales of ordinary shares up to $3,789,822. As of July 31, 2026, the company had already sold 6,762,825 shares for net proceeds of approximately $6.7 million under the original agreement. This is a routine ATM facility update, not a special-situation event. No special-situation category applies; the filing is a routine shelf takedown/registration update, so the appropriate classification is None.
